audit_items.proof_trace: `claim_rebates` explicitly asserts `amount != 0` at L196, directly enforcing the property. This check is structurally backed by `update_user_rebate` (L298-300), which calls `destroy_zero()` on zero balances before invoking `record_user_rebates`, ensuring that any coin_type entry in `user_rebates_records` always holds a positive amount. After a claim, the entry is removed entirely (L197), not zeroed, so a subsequent claim on the same coin_type fails at the `contains` check.
